units: <cite ref="Sotah 42a:3">Sot. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>כת ל׳</he> the class of scorners.
Snh. 101ᵃ, v. כִּנּוֹר; a. fr.—מושב ל׳ (Ps. I, 1) scorners’ gathering, bad company.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 41a:1">Kidd. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>מושבו מושב ל׳</he> his company is the bad company (meant in Ps. l. c.).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18b:16">Ab. Zar. 18ᵇ</cite> (<he>אסור</he>) <he>מפני מ׳ ל׳</he> (is forbidden as) coming under the category of being in bad company; a. fr.
